question: Find the volume of a hemisphere whose diameter is 6 cm. (Take π=22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of hemisphere = 6 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Volume of Hemisphere = 2/3 π r³ 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41df9931ecd74fa67901f70e05ddfcdccfd0fd515d5db67f551b7cc88f1585fb.png] 

Radius (r) = Diameter/2

⇒ r = 6/2 = 3 cm

Now Volume of the hemisphere

V = 2/3 π (3)³ 

⇒ V = 2/3 π (27) 

⇒ V = 2 × 9 π = 18π cm³ 

**∴ The volume of a hemisphere is 18π cm3. **
